terminology.Organiser: The user persona who interacts with the Agentforce agent to view matches and assign crew
terminology.Admin: The user persona who manages master data (teams, stadiums, staff)
terminology.Match Assignment: The junction object linking a Staff Member to a Match for a specific role
terminology.Set: The final confirmed status of a Match once minimum crew thresholds are met
terminology.Staffing: The in-progress status of a Match while crew is being assigned

decision_log.decision: Apex @InvocableMethod per action (compound-per-action pattern) over Flow for scheduling logic
decision_log.rationale: Flow cannot perform reliable datetime overlap arithmetic across records; Apex gives testable, single-responsibility classes per action

decision_log.decision: Master-Detail relationship from Match_Assignment to Match (not Lookup)
decision_log.rationale: Cascade-delete semantics — assignments are owned by and deleted with their Match

decision_log.decision: Crew thresholds hardcoded as Apex constants for Phase 1
decision_log.rationale: Sufficient for demo; Custom Metadata is the Phase 2 upgrade path if configurable thresholds are required

decision_log.decision: Crew minimums are fixed (4 ground staff, 2 commentators, 3 camera operators) — same for all stadiums
One role per person per match — no dual-role assignments
If no staff available for a role: agent alerts and stops, no auto-reassignment
No backup/reserve concept in Phase 1 — all assignments are active crew
